Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: every wrong submission costs 1 and every demo request costs 1. An
instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt cap is reached, and
reaching the cap is charged the full cap. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

H=W=18
src={(7,12),(7,13),(8,5),(8,6),(8,10),(8,11),(8,12),(8,13),(8,14),(9,5),(9,6),(9,7),(9,8),(9,9),(9,10),(9,11),(10,6),(10,10),(10,11),(11,6),(11,8),(11,9),(11,10),(11,11),(11,12),(12,6),(12,10),(13,5),(13,6),(14,5),(14,6)}
# Use 1-index coordinates. Axis rows/cols specified by the two marker beams.
hr, vc = 10, 9
# Every 7 on either beam stays; all other cells are partitioned into quadrants and packed into the corresponding corner.
out=[[1]*W for _ in range(H)]
# retain axis 7s
for r,c in src:
    if r==hr or c==vc:
        out[r-1][c-1]=7
# pack off-axis quadrant pixels to each corresponding corner based on each quadrant's own bbox
for rside in ('up','down'):
  for cside in ('left','right'):
    group={(r,c) for r,c in src if (r<hr if rside=='up' else r>hr) and (c<vc if cside=='left' else c>vc)}
    if not group: continue
    rmin=min(r for r,c in group); rmax=max(r for r,c in group)
    cmin=min(c for r,c in group); cmax=max(c for r,c in group)
    dr=(1-rmin) if rside=='up' else (H-rmax)
    dc=(1-cmin) if cside=='left' else (W-cmax)
    print(rside,cside,'bbox',(rmin,rmax,cmin,cmax),'delta',(dr,dc),'n',len(group))
    for r,c in group: out[r+dr-1][c+dc-1]=7
# draw 2 rays from each boundary marker up to the farthest original 7 on its line, retaining 7s
# bottom c9 upward
v_positions=[r for r,c in src if c==vc]
for r in range(max(v_positions),H+1):
    if out[r-1][vc-1]!=7: out[r-1][vc-1]=2
# right r10 leftward
h_positions=[c for r,c in src if r==hr]
for c in range(min(h_positions),W+1):
    if out[hr-1][c-1]!=7: out[hr-1][c-1]=2
print('axis 7',[(r,c) for r,c in src if r==hr or c==vc])
for row in out: print(' '.join(map(str,row)))
